name: Steady Hand
blurb: Slowest and most exact. Keeps the most small detail.

name: Studio Standard
blurb: The current Plotter Studio default, as a baseline to beat.

name: Balanced
blurb: A little faster everywhere, with the face at about the same pace as Standard.

name: Event Pace
blurb: The booth's event setup: quick body, careful face.

name: Quick Body, Slow Face
blurb: Pushes the body harder and skips the tiniest stray lines outside the face.

name: Speed Ceiling
blurb: Deliberately aggressive, to find where quality falls apart. Expect shaking.

name: Soft Curves
blurb: Gentle starts and turns with extra smoothing, for flowing lines.

name: Crisp Corners
blurb: Moderate speed with snappy turns and less smoothing, for sharp features.

name: Clean & Simple
blurb: Removes specks and short stray lines for fewer pen lifts and a tidier look.

name: Outlines Only
blurb: Never colors in thick areas. Draws them as a single line instead.
